name: Mikaguki Himenomiya
source: Exuberant like Nerisu, Mikazuki is the king of Dreilune. He rules happily with skill, having studied a Bachelor in Politics, minoring in Economics. He is very overprotective, the main reason why Nerisu has never dated before. He enjoys nothing more than to hang out with his friends, and is a stellar cook.
